checks: Real sample 3D Tiles: mouse down/move/up commits translation
One undo restores original transform; redo restores committed transform
Escape during a second active pointer gesture restores original transform
Real GLB tower anchored at ground level: pointer drag commits translation and undo restores original transform
implementation: Translation handles use a stable offset from the geographic anchor to the bounding center; arrows extend beyond the object radius and follow live translation.
limitations: Browser evidence; this run does not certify native desktop input, Windows scaling, or physical GPU behavior. Rotation, scale and plane constraints are covered by unit tests rather than this pointer suite.
